label: Specifications posterior to one fixed intrinsic actuality
definition: For every eligible specification c, a nonempty finite chain in the SAME world-indexed Arena.explains relation runs from the fixed target actuality fact to specification(c). Relation.TransGen supplies finite-chain semantics without a finite bound on the carrier. The specification map sends items to the fact relevant to the proposed dependence: for an intentional content this may be its intentional presence; for a formal mode, its derivative specification. Neither is automatically the existence of an external object. Example: an act explains a content being apprehended; a nature explains a derivative mode specification. Counterexample: a fact about a separate operation being prior to that operation, with no path from the selected target. No transitivity or asymmetry of Arena.explains is built into this predicate.
note: Analyst formulation, attribution deferred. This is an OPEN directional premise over the PSR arena fe4b7da0-cbd6-5d1f-b589-953f9def12b7; strictness is supplied separately by fe123142-31a9-49b5-840b-716bd6a0a98f. It asserts a dependence, not that every intentional object or formal mode has that dependence.
